An '''agricultural expert''' was a specialist in agriculture, the science of farming [[Plant/Legends|plants]]. [[Tayvor Mandirly]], brother to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Mazicia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], was a renowned agricultural expert until he was murdered on [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]].<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>
